title: Upper ball-mass bound at a weighted approximate tangent point
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and H^n := μHE[n] on ℝ^N = Euclidean N. Let M ⊆ ℝ^N be H^n-null-measurable, θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with θ ≥ 0 on M, x ∈ M, P a linear subspace of ℝ^N, and r₀ > 0 with θ H^n-integrable on M ∩ B̄_{r₀}(x). Assume M has weighted approximate tangent space P at x with respect to θ (Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P). Let ν := (H^n⌞M).withDensity(ofReal ∘ θ) and ω̂_n := unitBallVolume n. Then for every c ∈ [0, ∞] with ofReal(θ(x)) · ω̂_n < c, eventually as t → 0⁺: ν(B̄_t(x)) ≤ c · ofReal(t)^n.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ) (x : Euclidean N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Euclidean N)) (r₀ : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 ≤ θ y) → x ∈ M → 0 < r₀ → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall x r₀) μHE[n] → Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) * unitBallVolume n < c → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), (((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict M).withDensity fun y ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (θ y)) (closedBall x t) ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n
